summary: Source macOS typed TaskIR dispatch derives an explicit encoding capability from integrity, excludes old/unprofiled/role-only/method-missing peers and preserves requirements through generic RPC calls. Ten Rust/Elixir tasks execute through actual HTTP/Agent transport and recover original receipts after Orchestra restart without execution. Agent restart returns unknown outcomes without replay or publication. Separate follow-up evidence covers bounded native workflow continuation; defaults, installed mixed-peer and package-host qualification remain open.

required_text: unknown old and role-only peers are not typed digest fallbacks
generic task RPC cannot override the derived capability with empty caller requirements
unavailable typed peer does not transport-failover to an old peer
receipt retrieval or rejected drift must not execute
lost Agent receipts are not replay authority
This is bounded read-only receipt recovery
Installed typed workflow continuation remains open
